findings.issue: The table gives ~115 pm as a typical N=O double-bond length. A representative value is about 120–122 pm; approximately 115 pm is the bond length of neutral diatomic NO, whose bond order is approximately 2.5.
findings.evidence: This error is inherited from the supplied worked example, but agreement with the source does not establish chemical correctness. Standard chemistry bond-length data place a typical N=O double bond near 121 pm. Replace ~115 pm with ~121 pm; nitrite's approximately 124 pm bonds remain intermediate between representative single- and double-bond lengths.
